call.transcript:
Agent: Hello, this is Retell support. How can I assist you?
User: Hi, I wanted to cancel my monthly subscription.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear you want to cancel. Can you share why you are choosing to unsubscribe?
User: I just don't use it enough to justify the price.
Agent: Understood. I have successfully canceled your subscription. You won't be charged again.
User: Great, thank you. Have a good one.
Agent: Thank you for your time, goodbye.
call.callSummary: Customer requested subscription cancellation. Agent processed the cancellation and confirmed no further charges will occur.
